page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance type built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance provides 64 dedicated physical cores with 64 vCPUs, utilizing a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. This hardware layout is paired with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 30 Gbps, which facilitates high-throughput data transfers. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high core density provide stable, predictable compute resources without the performance variability associated with shared-core or burstable instances.

The balanced vCPU-to-memory ratio of the ecs.g5ne.16xlarge makes it suitable for multi-threaded applications, enterprise-grade web serving, application servers, and medium-sized databases. The 30 Gbps network baseline also supports distributed application architectures and containerized microservices that demand reliable inter-node communication.
